sentences.en: I knew it was plastic but it tasted like wood.
sentences.zh: 我知道那是塑料的，但尝起来像木头。

sentences.en: The fire is going out; will you add some wood?
sentences.zh: 火快灭了；你再加点木头行吗？

sentences.en: He lost his sense of direction in the dark woods.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗的树林里他迷失了方向。

senses.zh: 植林于；给…添加木柴Wood伍德(姓氏)
